img.1.description: Square-cropped landscape graphic with a heavily blurred, out-of-focus photographic background. A soft blue sky band occupies the top third, transitioning through green mid-tones to warm yellow-green and olive shapes (suggesting backlit foliage or grass) across the lower half; several soft circular bokeh highlights are visible. Three tiers of white text are centred horizontally: a tiny glyph plus “/ GET STARTED TODAY” in small, widely letterspaced capitals; a large headline “AI agents for hospitality”; and beneath it the lowercase word “conduit” in a heavier weight.
img.1.title: “AI agents for hospitality” conduit wordmark card on blurred sky-and-foliage background
img.1.usage_note: USABLE AS A PRESENTATION OR HERO-STYLE IMAGE WHERE A CALM, PHOTOGRAPHIC BACKDROP IS NEEDED FOR A SHORT POSITIONING LINE.

img.11.description: A UI mockup shown on a 1170×1020 raster frame. A translucent white, rounded-corner list panel sits right of center and lists six third-party apps, each row containing a small colored app icon, an app name, a light-gray pill with a tool count, and a blue pill-shaped toggle switch in the on position. A separate small white rounded-square card at the left holds a single dark abstract knot mark, connected to the panel by a thin horizontal line. The background is a soft gradient that runs blue at the left, pink-magenta through the middle, orange-amber at the right, fading to near-white across the upper band, with a visible halftone dot screen texturing the colored lower two-thirds.
img.11.title: Integrations toggle panel over a halftone-dot color gradient
img.11.usage_note: When to use: as a visual for explaining integrations, connectors, or 'works with the tools you already use' messaging; for feature-tour, marketplace, or settings-panel storytelling; for product pages where a clean, low-density UI panel needs to read at small sizes. Avoid when: the surface requires verified screenshots of the live product, exact feature parity, or accessibility-critical text rendering (the panel copy is small and baked into pixels); also avoid when a neutral, colorless background is required, since the halftone gradient is strongly tinted. Crop/placement: the panel occupies the middle-right; a left-weighted or centered crop keeps the mark card and the list together, while a right-only crop isolates the app rows. Because the upper third is near-empty light gradient, headline text can be overlaid there if contrast is checked. Do not place the frame over a busy or similarly warm background; the orange-pink right edge will clash. If a transparent cut-out is needed, note that this file has no alpha — the panel would have to be re-created, not extracted.

img.12.title: A_couple_holding_hands_in_a_sunlit_park_setting
img.12.usage_note: Use to evoke warmth, companionship, or wellness in CTA sections, service cards, or editorial features about relationships and shared experiences.

img.13.title: Abstract halftone gradient texture in teal and warm coral

img.17.usage_note: Use this asset to illustrate multilingual support, language selection, or chat interface features. It is suitable for product pages, feature highlights, or documentation.

img.18.description: A stylized computer window, styled like a terminal or editor, floats over a diagonal gradient from bright blue through cyan and teal to warm orange, overlaid with a halftone dot pattern. The window is white, with a title bar containing three small gray circles at the left and the text 'conduit ~ api' centered, followed by a monospaced code block showing a curl POST request to https://api.conduit.ai/v1/agent with an authorization header, a JSON message about resolving a ticket, and a JSON response indicating success.
img.18.title: Conduit API mock terminal window on halftone gradient
img.18.usage_note: Appropriate wherever a technical product needs to signal an API-first, developer-focused capability, embed a request/response example, or illustrate integration with an agent or ticket workflow. Works as a hero visual, a feature-section illustration, or a documentation callout where the message is 'a simple HTTP call gets the job done'. It is best paired with copy that explains the API, SDK, or agent functionality it depicts.

img.19.description: A screenshot of a software interface showing a chat interaction with an AI agent named 'Operator'. The interface displays a user query about leads performance, a thought process indicator, a summary response, and a bar chart with a legend breaking down lead sources by percentage.
img.19.title: Operator AI Agent Leads Performance UI Screenshot
img.19.usage_note: This image is suitable for illustrating product features related to AI agents, analytics, or lead generation. It can be used in marketing materials, product documentation, or website sections that explain how the software works. img.2.description: A UI card showing an application interface with agent inbox, conversation list, and an Operator panel. The interface includes sidebars, message rows, avatars, labels, buttons, and a floating assistant panel.
img.2.title: Conduit product screenshot in card implementation

img.20.description: A rectangular, rounded-corner light UI panel floats over a pale, softly tinted background. The panel is a workflow editor. A breadcrumb row at the top reads 'Workflow > Maintenance Issues' followed by a small green pill reading 'Active'. Below it is a horizontal tab row: 'Editor' (with a small icon, underlined and visually selected), 'Runs' (with a small icon) and 'Scheduled' (with a clock icon). At the far left of the panel is a narrow vertical icon toolbar holding a column of small monochrome line icons (an import/download-style arrow, several small glyphs, and what read as undo/redo arrows); the icons are not accompanied by legible text. The main canvas has a pale dot-grid background. On the canvas, a blue-tinted rounded rectangle node is labelled with a small blue pill reading 'Trigger' above it; the node contains a small tag glyph, the title 'Conversation tag Added' and the secondary line 'When a conversation tag is added'. A vertical connector line runs down from this node to a small circular '+' button, then continues to a second node. The second node is labelled with a magenta/pink pill reading 'Send AI Message' above it; the node contains a small paper-plane-style glyph, the title 'Send AI Message', an ellipsis '…' affordance at its right edge, and the secondary line 'Submit ticket in portal'. A short connector continues below it. At the extreme left edge of the image, outside the UI panel, a narrow vertical strip of dense blue/cyan halftone dot texture is visible, appearing to be a decorative graphic partly hidden behind the screenshot.
img.20.title: Workflow builder UI screenshot — 'Maintenance Issues' automation with Trigger and Send AI Message nodes

img.21.description: Portrait photograph of a wood-paneled cabin living room. A central stone chimney rises to a vaulted wood ceiling. At its base is a stone fireplace with a lit fire; above the mantel is a black flat-screen TV. Above the TV hangs an antler chandelier with small lights. Behind the chimney is a large arched window divided by wood mullions, showing dense green forest and a small patch of blue sky. In the foreground are a wooden coffee table, a patterned red rug, a tan leather ottoman, and part of a leather sofa. To the left is a wooden side table or cabinet; to the right is a side table with a lamp and a cushion. No text, logo, or transparency is visible.
img.21.title: Cabin Interior with Stone Fireplace, TV, Antler Chandelier, and Arched Forest Window
img.21.usage_note: Use when depicting cozy cabin interiors, stone fireplaces, forest views, rustic or luxury mountain homes, or lifestyle, real estate, and hospitality content. Suitable as a vertical hero, section background, or card image if the fireplace and window remain visible.

img.22.description: Vertical photograph of an urban street scene at golden hour. A tall light-colored building with a grid of windows occupies the center-left, reflecting warm light. To its right, a red-brick building with arched windows and decorative brickwork rises; its parapet bears white lettering reading 'CONFIDENCE'. Green tree branches frame the upper left and lower foreground. The sky is pale with soft clouds, lit warm from the left. In the lower left distance, smaller brick buildings are visible. A small dark sign on a pole near the center is not clearly legible.
img.22.title: Golden-Hour Urban Architecture with CONFIDENCE Building Sign
img.22.usage_note: Use for editorial, architectural, urban, real estate, or atmospheric design contexts needing a warm, vertical city photo. Suitable as a section background, card image, or article illustration where the building sign and golden-hour mood are relevant.

img.23.description: Light-mode product UI screenshot of a skill/agent configuration editor. A narrow left sidebar, a wide main editor column, a persistent command palette dropdown overlaying the lower-left of the editor, and a slim top toolbar with a skill title, a blue toggle switch, and an 'Edit with Operator' action on the right.
img.23.title: Software UI screenshot: 'Appliance Work Order Generation' skill editor with an open slash-command menu
img.23.usage_note: Use as a product screenshot in a card, feature block, or documentation figure to illustrate skill/procedure authoring in an agent platform: natural-language procedure steps plus inline tool/action tokens. Suits contexts that need to show a real interface at readable scale.

img.24.description: A vertical, low-angle photograph of a tall glass-and-steel skyscraper rising against a blue sky with faint clouds. The central tower has a narrow, vertically striated curtain wall and a stepped or tapering profile near the top. To the left, another high-rise with light cladding and horizontal window bands angles inward due to perspective. At the lower right, a dark streetlamp arm curves over the scene; a partial blue-glass building and a possible construction crane/mast appear at the right edge. The tower's base/podium includes dark reflective glass and tan/beige cladding, with reflections and possible small signage that is not legible at this resolution. No clearly visible people are present.
img.24.title: Low-Angle Urban Skyscraper Photograph
img.24.usage_note: Use when an urban, architectural, construction, real estate, proptech, infrastructure, or enterprise-technology context benefits from a vertical cityscape. Suitable for backgrounds, editorial headers, or card imagery where a low-angle skyscraper conveys scale and modernity.

img.25.description: Photograph of a warm wood-paneled room with a coffered dark wood and white ceiling, a multi-pane window with red curtains on the left, two dark leather armchairs, a glass-top coffee table on a metal base, built-in wooden shelving and cabinetry, a large ornately carved fireplace mantel, a patterned rug on hardwood floor, and a bright blue tufted sofa or ottoman in the foreground, partly covered by a white fluffy throw. No people, text, logo, or product are visible.
img.25.title: Wood-Paneled Interior with Blue Tufted Sofa and Leather Chairs
img.25.usage_note: Can be used as a card image, article thumbnail, editorial interior-design visual, or section background when the design needs a traditional, rich, wood-heavy, vintage or luxury-home feel.

img.26.description: A white, borderless UI fragment showing three stacked list rows. Rows one and two each show a gray identifier label at left ('CG - 121', 'CG - 122') and an orange 'Pending' pill at right. Row three shows 'CG - 123' at left with a light-green 'Resolved' pill at right; directly beneath that identifier a two-line bold dark heading is truncated ('How can I resolve unassigned conversation issues caused by workflo…') followed by a smaller gray single-line subtitle, also truncated ('Comprehensive guide on organizing knowledge…'). At the bottom of the fragment, a faint divider line separates a footer strip containing a small dark circular glyph, the gray text 'Missing Info', the gray text '# issues', and a solid red rounded pill containing white text '123'. The topmost row is partially cut by the crop; a very light gray horizontal band sits behind the second row, and a very faint vertical/left edge suggests a container or table boundary. No people, no product hardware, no logo, no button chrome, no navigation. The composition is centered horizontally with generous white negative space above, below and to both sides; the UI cluster occupies roughly the middle third of the frame. Text is the dominant visual content; hierarchy runs ID label (small gray) → status pill (colored) → bold headline → muted subtitle → footer metadata.
img.26.title: Conduit-style ticket list UI with a Pending/Resolved queue and an expanded 'Missing Info' entry
img.26.usage_note: This can be used as an illustrative screenshot for product features such as an escalation queue, inbox triage, ticket status tracking, or an 'unresolved items' surface. It works well wherever the message is 'AI handled most things, but here are the items that need a human' or 'review outstanding issues in one place.' Because the crop is generic (no browser frame, no branding), it can sit inside a card, a bento tile, a feature accordion panel, a help-center article, or a comparison table row without looking like a device screenshot. It is also suitable as a background for short overlay copy in the white space, though text is small in the lower area, so keep overlays away from the right-hand pills and the bottom footer.

img.27.description: A vertical photograph showing a thatched-roof villa on a tropical hillside, with a wooden balcony, lounge chairs, tall palm trees, an infinity pool, green lawn, magenta flowering shrubs, and an ocean cliff in the background under a pale dusk sky.
img.27.title: Tropical cliffside villa with infinity pool and palm trees at dusk
img.27.usage_note: Suitable for travel, hospitality, real estate, or lifestyle contexts where a serene tropical villa scene is relevant. Can be used as a hero image, card image, or section background if text overlay is placed in open sky or pool areas.

img.28.description: Static vertical photograph of a dense city at dusk. Roughly the upper third of the frame is sky: soft, hazy cloud bands in muted lavender, pale pink and grey with a slightly warmer glow low on the horizon. Below the sky a skyline spans the width of the frame, dominated in the right-of-centre by a tight cluster of three or four very tall, dark, flat-topped residential towers whose window grids are lit in warm white and yellow; a shorter tower with a brighter, warmer-glowing top sits just to the left of this cluster. To the left of the tall towers, a large dark green mass of trees and parkland reads as a low horizontal band, with distant mid-rise buildings and scattered lit windows behind it. The lower half and foreground are filled edge to edge with layered mid-rise and low-rise blocks — cream, beige, white and grey facades, many with orange-yellow lit windows, some with visible balconies and roof structures. Lights along streets and inside buildings give the foreground a warm dotted texture against the cooler sky. The camera is elevated and looks slightly downward across the city; no people, vehicles or individual street detail are legible. The image is fully opaque, edge-to-edge photographic content, with no lettering, signage, watermark or logo visible anywhere in the frame.
img.28.title: Dusk City Skyline With High-Rise Cluster and Park Greenery
img.28.usage_note: Use as an editorial or atmospheric background evoking urban scale, city life, evening or a 'built environment' theme; suitable for hero banners, section dividers, card thumbnails, blog/article headers, real-estate or proptech storytelling, and as a neutral backdrop behind overlaid text or UI. Works as a mood/context image rather than as evidence of a specific place or product.

img.29.description: A white rounded rectangular card on a black background. The card contains a line chart titled 'AI Resolution Rate' with a large '87%' value and '80% previous period' below it. A blue line fluctuates across a white chart area with y-axis labels 0, 60, 70, 80 and x-axis labels Mar 15 and Mar 22. A black cursor arrow points to a point on the line near the middle. A three-dot ellipsis icon appears in the top-right corner.
img.29.title: AI Resolution Rate analytics card
img.29.usage_note: Use when illustrating AI performance monitoring, resolution-rate analytics, or a dashboard-style metric card in a product feature section.

img.3.description: A square, dark-toned photographic frame dominated by rough, granular surface texture. The image has no clearly readable objects, figures, or legible text; the visible content consists of mottled black, brown, and low-value gray areas with irregular variations in brightness. The composition appears evenly filled, with no obvious subject isolation or focal point. Because the source is a rasterized, downscaled preview rather than a full-resolution original, transparency, exact crop boundaries, and fine detail cannot be verified.
img.3.title: Dark Textured Square Photograph
img.3.usage_note: Use as a full-bleed background or texture layer where a dark, gritty, abstract surface is appropriate. It can sit behind white or light-colored text if contrast is verified at final size. It is not suitable as a stand-alone informative image because it carries no readable subject or product content.

img.30.description: A vertical photograph of a city skyline at dusk. The sky transitions from blue at the top to warm orange, pink, and yellow near the horizon. Several high-rise buildings of varying heights and styles are visible; one building on the left has a green/yellow top, and one building on the right has a blue dome-like roof. An elevated roadway or overpass crosses horizontally through the midground, with a lower blue-lit structure and paved parking area below. In the foreground, palm trees, green grass, and a curved road with lane markings frame the scene. No readable text, logos, or watermarks are visible.
img.30.title: Sunset City Skyline with Elevated Roadway and Palm Trees
img.30.usage_note: Use as a vertical hero, background, or card image for urban, travel, real estate, city lifestyle, or technology contexts where a warm dusk skyline and palm trees fit. Suitable when text overlay can sit in the upper sky negative space.

img.31.description: A wide view of a hotel lobby with a large rug, seating areas, and a reception desk.
img.31.title: Hotel Lobby Interior
img.31.usage_note: Use this image in a card, hero, or section background for a hospitality or real estate layout.

Above it, roughly centered horizontally, sits an equally faint, indistinct pale-gray emblem shape with a compact rounded upper form and a wider lower form, reading as a small stacked mark or monument-like silhouette. The contrast between mark and background is very low, so internal detail of the emblem is not resolvable at the supplied preview scale. img.33.description: Vertical photograph showing a modern covered outdoor patio. A dark roof fascia and warm wood-slat ceiling extend diagonally across the upper half. Below, a concrete floor holds a round wooden table with woven chairs on the left, a white upholstered sofa/daybed in the center, and a wooden-framed sofa with white cushions on the right. Two woven pendant lights hang from the ceiling. The background includes a white wall with circular wooden wall decor, a dark rectangular screen/opening, an orange-tan wall, and a textured brick/stone wall. The foreground shows wooden decking; sky with clouds is visible above the roof.
img.33.title: Covered Outdoor Patio with Wooden Ceiling and Lounge Furniture
img.33.usage_note: Use as a hero or section background for architecture, real estate, construction, outdoor living, or interior design content; can also be cropped for cards or inline editorial imagery.

img.34.description: A vertical photograph of a modern multi-story building at twilight. A central curved tower with light beige brick and dark rectangular windows dominates the frame. Some windows are lit warm yellow. To the right, a lower flat-roofed section with similar brick and dark windows. At ground level, vertical slats are illuminated with warm orange light, with a planter of green shrubs and a low wall. A dark rectangular sign with white lettering reads 'MERCER' on the right. Foreground includes concrete sidewalk, green lawn, and a small illuminated bollard. Sky is deep blue/purple with tree branches at upper right.

img.34.usage_note: Use for architectural, real estate, urban development, twilight exterior, modern building, or property-related editorial/website imagery. Suitable as a vertical hero/section image when an atmospheric building photo is needed.

img.35.description: A centered, circular white badge with a scalloped outer edge and a thin dark outline or shadow. Inside is a black caduceus-like symbol with wings and entwined serpents above the bold uppercase word 'HIPAA'. The badge appears on a white background in the supplied preview.
img.35.title: HIPAA Compliance Seal
img.35.usage_note: Use as a supporting trust mark in healthcare-compliance or data-safeguards content, especially near copy about HIPAA workflows and protected data.

img.36.description: A square, roughly 1:1 graphic on a white field. Centered is a round white disc bearing two stacked lines of uppercase, dark near-black sans-serif text: 'SOC 2' on the first line and 'TYPE II' on the second. The disc is enclosed by a scalloped, rosette-like ring of soft rounded lobes rendered in a very light gray, with a faint drop shadow that separates the white shape from the white background. No other marks, borders, textures, gradients, or imagery are present. There is no visible logo, wordmark, or company identifier inside or around the badge.
img.36.title: Scalloped 'SOC 2 TYPE II' Compliance Seal
img.36.usage_note: Use as a compact credibility/trust token next to short supporting copy, in a compliance or security strip, in a footer credentials row, or inside a feature card, list item, or tooltip where the accompanying text explains what the attestation covers. It reads clearly at small sizes because the two text lines are the only content and remain legible when the badge is scaled down.

img.37.description: A vertical cityscape image showing a river, bridge, and dense urban skyline under a pale blue sky with golden haze near the horizon. A tall, slender residential tower with an irregular white balcony grid dominates the right side. A blue-clad mid-rise building with a white vertical structural frame sits near the center. In the foreground, a paved street or embankment runs across the bottom with two cars and some trees. Two airplane contrails cross the sky diagonally.
img.37.title: River City Architectural Rendering with Tall Residential Tower

img.38.description: Vertical photograph of a two-story suburban house exterior at dusk. The house has gray horizontal siding, white trim, dark roof shingles, and a front-facing garage on the left. A small plaque above the garage door appears to read '7058'. A covered front porch has white columns, stone veneer at the base, a dark front door with a wreath, and an American flag hanging from the porch. Two blue pots with plants sit near the porch. A concrete driveway with expansion joints fills the foreground. The sky above is dramatic with purple, pink, orange, and blue clouds.

img.38.usage_note: Suitable for contexts about residential real estate, home exteriors, suburban neighborhoods, curb appeal, homeownership, or patriotic/seasonal themes when an American flag is appropriate. Could serve as a background, hero, card, or editorial image if cropped appropriately.

img.39.description: A centered white scalloped circular badge with a soft shadow, containing a dark shield shape with a white padlock icon. The background is solid black. No text is visible.
img.39.title: Enterprise Security Lock Badge Icon
img.39.usage_note: Use as a visual marker for security, encryption, access control, or trust-related content; suitable for feature cards, security sections, or badges where a simple lock/shield symbol is appropriate.

img.4.description: A single flat graphic shape occupying the centre of a square 512×512 frame: a thick, right-pointing chevron (an angular '>' form) with rounded corners at every vertex and soft, slightly tapered stroke ends. The chevron is filled with a uniform light warm beige/cream tone and sits on a plain white field. No other elements, textures, gradients, shadows or text are visible. The shape is centred horizontally and vertically with wide, even margins on all four sides.
img.4.title: Pale beige rounded chevron / right-pointing arrow glyph on white
img.4.usage_note: Likely usable as a directional/affordance icon in a UI: a 'next', 'continue', 'open' or 'expand' indicator, a list-row disclosure glyph, a carousel/pagination control, or a decorative accent inside a larger illustration. Also plausible as a soft-branded arrow in an empty-state or onboarding graphic where a low-contrast, friendly tone is wanted rather than a hard black glyph.

img.40.description: Vertical photograph of an outdoor terrace lounge under a covered overhang. In the foreground, wooden lounge chairs with cream cushions surround a small wooden side table holding a dark bottle and two glasses. A palm frond enters at left. Beyond the seating, a low stone planter with green shrubs borders a blue ocean. The horizon line runs across the middle of the frame, with clear light-blue sky above and a warm tan ceiling edge at the top.
img.40.title: Sunlit Terrace Lounge Overlooking Ocean
img.40.usage_note: Use as a calm, aspirational lifestyle image for travel, hospitality, resort, outdoor-living, or leisure contexts. It can support hero, card, or inline placements where a serene ocean-view atmosphere is appropriate.

A dark wood-paneled wall section includes a glass door or partition with black framing. In the center-right, a built-in desk or bar area has a warm orange/copper countertop. The upper shelf holds a potted plant with long green leaves in a white vase and a round wooden object; the lower shelf holds a small wooden figurine. The background appears white/opaque in the supplied raster. No photographic or illustrative content is visible.
img.42.title: Nobu Hotels wordmark logo
img.42.usage_note: Use when a page or card needs to identify the Nobu Hotels brand or display a hospitality logo in a logo strip, partner grid, or brand card. Suitable for light backgrounds where the black wordmark and white outline remain legible.

img.43.description: Verticall interior photograph of a home. In the foreground, a medium-brown wood-plank floor leads toward a wooden staircase on the right. A white wall or column edge runs vertically through the center of the frame, separating the left living area from the right staircase. On the left, a white wall holds a large black flat-screen TV; below and in front of it is a light grey/off-white rug on the wood floor.
